title: What is Ajax's highest chance creation passing score and what is it classif
question:
What is Ajax's highest chance creation passing score and what is it classified as?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Ajax's refers to team_long_name = 'Ajax'; chance creation passing score refers to MAX(chanceCreationPassing); classified refer to chanceCreationPassingClass

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    MAX(pa.XCL_145) AS highest_chance_creation_passing_score,
    pa.XCL_134 AS classification
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.XCL_130 = p.XCL_122
WHERE p.XCL_123 = 'Ajax'
ORDER BY pa.XCL_145 DESC
LIMIT 1

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:

FROM Team_Attributes ta
JOIN Team t ON ta.XCL_177 = t.XCL_171
WHERE t.XCL_173 = 'Ajax'
ORDER BY ta.XCL_186 DESC
LIMIT 1;
